risk_candidate: Duplicate transfer/exchange/payment after double tap or retry
where_to_inspect: confirmation callbacks, service methods, interceptors, backend idempotency contract
safe_remediation_direction: disable duplicate UI submit plus backend-supported idempotency; do not assume client-only is enough

risk_candidate: False success displayed before authoritative backend confirmation
where_to_inspect: review/result/receipt widgets and API response mapping
safe_remediation_direction: represent pending/unknown accurately; success only on confirmed server state

risk_candidate: Authorization/passcode/KYC gate enforced only in UI
where_to_inspect: controllers, route guards, endpoint requests, backend docs
evidence_needed: client path and server policy evidence
safe_remediation_direction: confirm server-side enforcement; treat client as UX only

risk_candidate: Incorrect amount/currency scale or unsafe floating point in money path
safe_remediation_direction: integer minor units or decimal-safe arithmetic according to contract

risk_candidate: Fee/rate differs between quote, review, submit and receipt
safe_remediation_direction: keep authoritative quoted values and expiry; do not recalculate client-side unless contract says so

risk_candidate: Retry after timeout when transaction outcome is unknown
safe_remediation_direction: never blindly resubmit; reconcile transaction status using documented endpoint

risk_candidate: Sensitive token, PII, passcode, seed or key logged/persisted insecurely
safe_remediation_direction: remove/redact sensitive data; approved secure storage lifecycle

risk_candidate: Transaction status enum unknown mapped to success or failure incorrectly
safe_remediation_direction: preserve unknown as unknown and reconcile with server

risk_candidate: Stale balance persists after a mutation or cross-screen navigation
safe_remediation_direction: refresh/invalidate according to server contract

risk_candidate: Settings/config null or missing mapped to unsafe allow
where_to_inspect: remote settings parser and feature gates
safe_remediation_direction: fail-safe for sensitive action; distinguish missing, disabled, unknown

risk_candidate: Backend JSON key/type/nullability mismatch silently defaults value
safe_remediation_direction: strict typed mapping and explicit absent-field behavior

risk_candidate: Error mapping hides actionable server state or exposes raw sensitive message
where_to_inspect: Dio interceptors and UI error views
safe_remediation_direction: safe normalized errors with correlation IDs; avoid raw stack/body

risk_candidate: Quote expiry not checked before confirming financial operation
safe_remediation_direction: block expired quotes and obtain fresh quote per contract

risk_candidate: Submit action remains enabled while request pending
safe_remediation_direction: prevent accidental multiple taps; keep backend duplicate protection

risk_candidate: Navigation loses confirmed/pending operation context
safe_remediation_direction: safe navigation and server-based reconciliation
required_regression: back and reopen pending transaction test

risk_candidate: Pagination merges duplicate/misordered transaction rows
safe_remediation_direction: stable-key dedupe and correct reset/load-more behavior

risk_candidate: User-visible balance/receipt does not identify currency or fee meaning
safe_remediation_direction: explicit currency, fee, total and rate labels

risk_candidate: Localization/RTL changes amount or critical button order/meaning
where_to_inspect: all supported locales and key flows
safe_remediation_direction: test RTL and LTR separately; preserve semantic order

risk_candidate: A cached authorization/config value survives logout or user change
safe_remediation_direction: clear user-bound state and refresh authorization according to policy

risk_candidate: Deep link/notification accepts untrusted sensitive parameters
safe_remediation_direction: allowlist route/params and revalidate against server

risk_candidate: Empty/error/offline state implies transaction did not happen when status is unknown
safe_remediation_direction: explicitly distinguish unknown/pending; provide safe refresh path

risk_candidate: API retry policy retries non-idempotent POST implicitly
safe_remediation_direction: route retries only when contract proves safe

risk_candidate: Client trusts recipient/QR payload without backend validation
evidence_needed: request flow and server validation evidence
safe_remediation_direction: display verified details and require server-resolved intent

risk_candidate: Screen displays an action whose callback is absent or no-op
safe_remediation_direction: remove/disable or implement the action with test

risk_candidate: Existing design system component default status/action differs from business reality
safe_remediation_direction: pass actual status/callback explicitly; do not rely on unsafe defaults
